[[File:Small ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a small ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''small ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron''' (or '''small dodekified icosidodecahedron''') is a [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], indexed as U<sub>43</sub>. It has 44 faces (20 [[triangle]]s, 12 [[pentagram]]s and 12 [[decagon]]s), 120 edges, and 60 vertices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathconsult.ch/static/unipoly/43.html|title=43: small ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron|last=Maeder|first=Roman|date=|website=MathConsult|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> Its [[vertex figure]] is a [[quadrilateral#More quadrilaterals|crossed quadrilateral]].

== Related polyhedra ==

It shares its vertex arrangement with the [[great stellated truncated dodecahedron]]. It additionally shares its edges with the [[small icosicosidodecahedron]] (having the triangular and pentagrammic faces in common) and the [[small dodecicosahedron]] (having the decagonal faces in common).
